mapper.select: SELECT o.id AS orderId, o.order_no AS orderNo, o.status AS orderStatus, o.completed_at AS completedAt, oi.id AS orderItemId, oi.product_name AS productName, oi.spec AS spec, oi.unit_price AS unitPrice, oi.quantity AS quantity, oi.after_sale_deadline AS afterSaleDeadline, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(a.quantity), 0) FROM after_sale a WHERE a.order_item_id = oi.id AND a.status <> 'REJECTED') AS occupiedQuantity, (SELECT a.after_sale_no FROM after_sale a WHERE a.order_item_id = oi.id AND a.status NOT IN ('REJECTED', 'EXCHANGE_DONE', 'REFUND_DONE') LIMIT 1) AS inProgressAfterSaleNo FROM order_item oi JOIN mock_order o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.consumer_id = #{consumerId} AND o.status = 'FINISHED' ORDER BY o.id DESC, oi.id ASC
